reason: I've been cooking kra pao and khai jiao since I was a kid, I don't need my phone to tell me when the egg is done. On busy days I just buy a 50-baht plate anyway, so 99 baht a month for questions I'd never ask makes no sense.
objection: Only two dishes, and they're the two every Thai already knows. The free 3 questions a day is already more than I'd ever use, so the paid part gives me nothing.
would_change_my_mind: Lots of new dishes I can't already cook, all doable in my one pan with cheap ingredients, so cooking at home actually beats buying a plate. More questions alone won't do it.
